# Umay Garment — Custom Fur & Faux Fur Garment OEM/ODM Factory

> Jiaxing Umay Garment Co., Ltd. is a factory-direct fur garment manufacturer in Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China, specializing in OEM and ODM production of real fur, leather and eco-friendly faux fur outerwear for fashion brands, boutiques, wholesalers and e-commerce sellers in Europe, the USA, Central America and Northern Europe.

## Company

- Company name: Jiaxing Umay Garment Co., Ltd.
- Location: Jiaxing, Zhejiang Province, China
- Experience: 20+ years in fur garment manufacturing
- Factory status: Direct factory, onsite-verified by Alibaba.com (Onsite Check), Trade Assurance supported
- Contact person: Cathy
- Email: cathy@umaygarment.com
- WhatsApp: +86 188 5733 7355
- Website: https://www.umaygarment.com/
- Alibaba store: https://umaygarment.en.alibaba.com/

## Product Categories

- [Real Fox Fur Coats & Vests](https://www.umaygarment.com/products/fox-fur.html): Silver fox, arctic fox and red fox fur coats, cropped jackets and vests; natural or 50+ custom dyed colors; custom sizes XXS–6XL.
- [Real Raccoon Fur Jackets & Coats](https://www.umaygarment.com/products/raccoon-fur.html): Natural or dyed raccoon fur street-style jackets, fur-trimmed parkas and vests.
- [Mongolian Lamb & Sheep Shearling Coats](https://www.umaygarment.com/products/cashmere-sheep.html): Cashmere wool, double-face sheep shearling and lamb wool coats, classic aviator and long shearling styles.
- [Genuine Leather Jackets](https://www.umaygarment.com/products/leather-jacket.html): Cowhide, lambskin and sheepskin biker, bomber and trench jackets, optional fur collar or fur lining trim.
- [Eco-friendly Faux Fur Coats](https://www.umaygarment.com/products/faux-fur.html): Long pile, short pile and teddy faux fur; vegan-friendly; unlimited color options.

## Key Business Facts

- MOQ: 1 pc (samples and bulk orders)
- Sample lead time: 3–5 days
- Bulk production lead time: 15–20 days
- Design library: 2,000+ fur garment designs
- Customization: fabric, 50+ Pantone colors, sizes XXS–6XL (bust 80–120 cm), logo, main label, washing label, hang tag, brand packaging
- Quality control: 8-step production process; every garment hand-inspected before shipment
- Shipping: sea freight, air freight, DHL/FedEx to 50+ countries
- Services: OEM, ODM, private label; free 3D design mockup; quote within 24 hours

## FAQ

- Q: What is your MOQ? A: Our MOQ is 1 piece for samples and bulk orders.
- Q: Do you provide samples before bulk production? A: Yes, pre-production samples are ready in 3–5 days. The sample fee is refunded when your first bulk order exceeds 200 pieces.
- Q: Can you customize fabric, color, size and logo? A: Yes, full OEM/ODM — custom fabric, 50+ Pantone colors, sizes XXS–6XL (bust 80–120 cm), logo, main label, washing label, hang tag and brand packaging.
- Q: What materials do you offer? A: Real fox fur, real raccoon fur, genuine leather (cowhide, lambskin, sheepskin), cashmere wool, sheep shearling and eco-friendly faux fur.
- Q: What is your production lead time? A: Samples take 3–5 days; bulk production takes 15–20 days for standard OEM orders; ready stock ships within 7–10 days.
- Q: How do you control quality? A: Every order follows an 8-step process (raw material inspection, fur processing, cutting, sewing, quality check, finishing, finished-product inspection, packaging) and every garment is hand-inspected before shipment.
- Q: How do you ship internationally? A: Sea freight, air freight or DHL/FedEx to 50+ countries, with export documents and tracking for every order.
- Q: Do you offer faux fur / vegan fur options? A: Yes. Our eco-friendly faux fur collection offers realistic texture, unlimited colors, and is ideal for vegan brands and markets with fur import restrictions.
